items.title: KLA (KLAC) Posts Strong Q4 And Guides Higher On AI Demand
items.summary: KLA reported strong fiscal Q4 results, supported by demand tied to AI infrastructure and advanced packaging. The company issued upbeat guidance for fiscal Q1, pointing to continued interest in its process control tools and services. Management highlighted secular growth trends in AI and advanced packaging as key factors behind the latest update.
